data.description: Wrap a native file input in a polished drag-and-drop zone. The native input remains the source of truth, so it works inside any form unmodified.

data-aed-dz-headline.default: Drop files here or click to select

data-aed-dz-hint.description: Small secondary line under the headline (e.g. 'PDF or PNG, max 10 MB').

data-aed-dz-max-size.description: Maximum size per file in bytes. Files exceeding this are rejected.
